description: AI-powered code security auditor. Scans GitHub repos for vulnerabilities with OWASP/CWE references and remediation guidance.

rawRecord.description: AI-powered code security auditor. Scans GitHub repos for vulnerabilities with OWASP/CWE references and remediation guidance.

detail.description: AI-powered code security auditor. Scans GitHub repos for vulnerabilities with OWASP/CWE references and remediation guidance.

tools.name: security_scan
tools.description: Run a full security audit on a GitHub repository. Clones the repo, scans source files with LLM-powered analysis, returns OWASP/CWE findings with remediation. Takes 1-10 minutes.

branch.title: Branch
branch.description: Git branch to scan. Defaults to main.

repo_url.title: Repo Url
repo_url.description: GitHub repository URL to scan, e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo.

tools.name: audit_status
tools.description: Check the status of a running or completed security audit. Returns findings if complete.

audit_id.title: Audit Id
audit_id.description: The audit ID returned by security_scan.

tools.name: audit_list
tools.description: List recent security audits with summary information including status and risk scores.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of audits to return (1-50).

tools.name: audit_stats
tools.description: Get aggregate audit statistics — total scans, findings breakdown by severity, average risk score.

prompts.name: scan_workflow
prompts.description: Step-by-step guide to scan a repository for security vulnerabilities.

prompts.name: interpret_results
prompts.description: How to interpret audit results and prioritize fixes.
